The more synthetic type brushes are good for packing on wet product / glitter ect. I did notice some of the smaller detail brushes were practically the same but doesn't really bother me cause there's a lot of great brushes in this set. I love that there is such a large Variety in the different brushes that you can use. I am very much looking forward to keeping this set for a while. reviews.t: I love the BeautyWill Professional Makeup Brush set
reviews.x: I love the BeautyWill Professional Makeup Brush set, It arrived a week ahead of scheduled. It comes in a resealable package which is a plus. It did have a kind of strong smell when you first open the package but just let it air out for about an hour and it will be gone. It comes with 32 brushes total and that goes from bronzing, foundation, and eye-shadow brushes. It also includes a brush for your lips and eyebrows. It is wonderful and complete set. reviews.t: Great for the cheap price!
reviews.x: Love love love all the choices! Was skeptical because of the price, but was very happy that I went with it. Two of the brush tops were loose from the wood handle, but I just reapplied glue and they're fine.

reviews.t: Shitty brushes
reviews.x: I bought these brushes one month ago and they are already falling apart. Save your money and invest in something better.

reviews.t: Overall great brushes. They do the job
reviews.x: Overall great brushes. They do the job. Great value for what your paying. Only gave 4 stars because 2 of the brush heads are already beginning to fall off. They're 2 I'll barely ever use so it doesn't really affect me and the rest of the brushes have been fantastic.

reviews.t: Perfection!
reviews.x: Amazing product! Super fast shipping! Love!

reviews.t: LOVE LOVE LOVE- High quality & affordable
reviews.x: LOVE LOVE LOVE ❤❤❤ A lot of people ask "w Why would you need so many brushes, especially when a lot of them are pretty much the same?" In my opinion, that's exactly what I LOVE about this set. I hate having to  wipe off my darker colored eyeshadow when I'm about to use a light colored one. Now I have a brush for both. As for the "smell", yes it was potent when first opened, but I let it air out for a while and it went away. There are firm and sift bristles on the larger brishes.

reviews.t: Perfect for an adult - or a tween!
reviews.x: I bought these for my daughter for Christmas and I'm a little jealous - I want a set!  The large brush does fall out of the bag quite a bit, but if you wrap it tight enough, it will stay in.  This is perfect for any adult who doesn't want to spend a lot on brushes or perfect for a girl who is just learning about makeup and likes to watch YouTube ;).  If you found my review helpful, please click on the "helpful" button below.  Thank you!

reviews.t: Very useful and allows for creativity!
reviews.x: My wife loved the kit and uses it daily. A large variety of brush sizes. From what I hear, she can do more with her make up than before, so she's happy.

reviews.t: SUPER DUPER soft
reviews.x: They don't shed with washing.......SUPER DUPER soft ! Great buy.

reviews.t: The case is nice. Since the large fan brush isn't covered by ...
reviews.x: So far the brushes are ok. The small fan brush had glue on it in a couple spots. I got most of it out, but can't get all of it. I love how each brush is labeled with what it's best used for! The case is nice. Since the large fan brush isn't covered by the flap, it falls out sometimes, but not a big deal. reviews.t: Such beautiful brushes. I'm still figuring out what each one ...
reviews.x: Such beautiful brushes. I'm still figuring out what each one is for but it's fun experimenting with my makeup. I've washed them twice since buying with a natural brush cleanser & they haven't shed or lost any life. Very pleased.

reviews.t: I love these brushes
reviews.x: I love these brushes! The price was great and they are comparable to really high end brushes. My only complaint is they have a very strong smell when you first open them. I aired them out for a day or so and now I love them!

reviews.t: great price, great brushes
reviews.x: got here right on time & I am very impressed of the quality of the brushes! It does have a funky smell to it whenever you first open it but just let it air-dry and it'll go away asap!

reviews.t: These are nice. My daughter liked them
reviews.x: These are nice.  My daughter liked them.  Her only complaint was that each brush didn't specify the brush name and there wasn't a list specifying what each brush is used for.

reviews.t: Nice brush set

reviews.t: but all in all I love the brushes they are everything I hoped for

I had them send the item to a friend of mine who use a multitude of different brushes for make up and is always in need of something like this and this is what she had to say about the product. She absolutely loved the case that the brushes came in, the multitude of brushes is a definite plus for anyone who uses make up. The brushes themselves are super

reviews.t: These brushes are great! It came on time as promised and was ...
reviews.x: These brushes are great! It came on time as promised and was packaged well. This set includes 32 pieces all of which were individually wrapped and tucked inside the black carrying case. The black carrying case itself is good quality. It comes with a long string that doubles around the case once it's been roll tightly.  The brushes themselves are soft and seem to be a good quality. The eyeshadow brushes are all similar but this does not bother me because it makes it easier to find a clean brush.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the set as a great value for the low price, with quality comparable to higher-end brushes.
Many reviewers love the large variety of brushes included in the set.
Several reviewers note a strong smell when first opening the package, but say it fades after airing out.
Some reviewers report brush heads or tops coming loose or falling apart, though a few fixed them with glue.
Multiple reviewers mention the bristles are soft and don't shed after washing.
